line.en: 2026-11-01 grading: BTC missed the bias call at close (called short, moved 453.7 pts up with open interest falling, short-covering) and had no gradable bias at ny. BTC zones 1/2 touched worked (the A+ short failed at close hitting the stop on the strong rally, worked at ny); ETH zones 3/3 touched worked (the A+ short worked both runs, the B long worked at ny). Of the 4 text predictions: 2 hits (no 15m close broke the cited ceilings) and 2 misses (BTC and ETH both briefly cleared the prior day's range ceiling without closing above it, so the range itself did not hold).

updated.es: Lo que aguanto del close: las dos zonas (venta en el maximo, compra en el retroceso) y el veredicto WAIT en los dos simbolos, sin zona A+. Lo que cambio: ambos ya barrieron sus zonas de venta con mecha y se dieron la vuelta; BTC siguio cayendo y rompio la zona de compra 78,000 a 78,200 sin reclamo (ahora broken) y su checklist de tendencia confirmo corto de tamano normal (conviccion sube a media); ETH se repliega de vuelta dentro de su zona de venta y su fondeo paso de shorts-crowded a neutral. Riesgo de contexto se mantiene en MEDIO (hackeo de Binance con tono mas calmado, pero ventana de riesgo nueva por un titular de la ultima hora). NQ rebota desde su apertura; ETH acompana en parte, BTC diverge.
updated.en: What held from the close: both zones (sell at the high, buy at the pullback) and the WAIT verdict on both symbols, with no A+ zone. What changed: both already swept their sell zones with a wick and reversed; BTC kept falling and broke the 78,000 to 78,200 pullback long without a reclaim (now broken) and its trend checklist confirmed a normal-size short (conviction up to medium); ETH is pulling back inside its own sell zone and its funding went from crowded-short to neutral. Context risk stays at MEDIUM (the Binance hack with a calmer tone, but a new risk window for a headline from the last hour). NQ is rebounding off its open; ETH partly tracks it, BTC diverges.
